verdict.rationale: Convex is a managed reactive database with client/server SDKs, real-time sync, ACID transactions, HTTP API endpoints for calling functions from servers, and CLI for deployment management, all documented in first-party docs. Community evidence corroborates it as a functioning DB alternative to Supabase/Firebase. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarks/reports specifically verifying client+server SDK read/write flows, and no third-party corroboration beyond a single HN thread.
